products.title: Rainy Day Story Quest Pack
products.headline: A printable rainy-day writing pack for one quiet afternoon.
products.summary: Four weather-and-water quest worlds give reluctant writers a concrete map, a few tiny errands, and a short ending choice instead of a blank page.
products.checkoutNote: Checkout is pending until the payment provider is selected; this static page is ready for provider wiring but does not accept payment yet.
products.safetyNote: No scary harm, no bullying, no romance, no weapons, no branded characters, no real child profiles.
includedPages: Parent guide for a 35-minute writing session
useCases: A low-pressure writing activity when kids are stuck indoors
A homeschool language arts warm-up with weather observation
A tutoring or classroom station for short narrative practice
parentSteps: Pick one world and read the first prompt aloud.
Let the child point, circle, or label before writing full sentences.
End with two kind choices and let the child choose the ending.
